interactive.label: search_tools
interactive.tooltip: Filter imaging tools by name or description.

interactive.label: Setup
interactive.tooltip: Define detector channels and PIE time windows once for all imaging tools.

interactive.label: Browser
interactive.tooltip: Browse TTTR image files and explore intensity maps.

interactive.label: Drift
interactive.tooltip: Optional pre-processing: measure and remove inter-frame sample drift. Belongs before the numbered steps — every per-pixel map below is built from frames that must already be aligned. Photon streams are corrected photon by photon, so the steps below still see real photons.

interactive.label: Resolution
interactive.tooltip: How fine a detail this acquisition actually resolves, by Fourier ring correlation between two independent halves of it. Sits after Drift because drift blurs the image and so lowers the measured resolution — measure it on frames that are already aligned.

interactive.label: Flow
interactive.tooltip: Map the velocity field: one arrow per tile, over the image. Sits beside Tracking because both measure motion rather than building a per-pixel map -- and after Drift for the same reason Tracking is, since a drifting stage is indistinguishable from a sample flowing the other way. Tracking follows individual particles; this reads a velocity from the correlations of everything at once, so it works where the labels are too dense to resolve as spots.

interactive.label: Tracking
interactive.tooltip: Follow individual particles through the frames and fit their diffusion coefficient. Sits after Drift because a drifting sample looks exactly like directed motion, and outside the numbered steps because it measures motion rather than building a per-pixel map.

interactive.label: 1. Intensity
interactive.tooltip: Per-pixel intensity map; creates the standard imaging HDF5 (with source back-reference).

interactive.label: 2. Number & Brightness
interactive.tooltip: Per-pixel Number (N) and Brightness (B); adds fields to the imaging HDF5.

interactive.label: 3. Mean Micro-Time
interactive.tooltip: Per-pixel mean micro-time (arrival time, ns) per detector window; adds fields to the imaging HDF5.

interactive.label: 4. IRF & BG
interactive.tooltip: Optional: per-detector IRF file + background (kHz); transferred to Phasor and MLE. Skippable.

interactive.label: 5. Phasor-FLIM
interactive.tooltip: Per-pixel phasor (g, s) maps and phasor plot; adds fields to the imaging HDF5.

interactive.label: 6. Pixel-wise MLE
interactive.tooltip: Pixel-wise MLE lifetime analysis; adds fields to the imaging HDF5.

interactive.label: CLSM Draw
interactive.tooltip: Interactive CLSM pixel selection, ROI drawing and decay extraction; opens imaging HDF5 (via source back-reference).

interactive.label: Spot Finder
interactive.tooltip: Find the regions — molecules, beads, objects — and write them, with their pixels, into each measurement's container.

interactive.label: Region MLE
interactive.tooltip: Lifetime MLE per region, on the regions the Spot Finder found.

interactive.label: PSF Determination
interactive.tooltip: 3D Gaussian PSF fitting and bead detection.

interactive.label: Back
interactive.tooltip: Go to the previous tool in the list.

interactive.label: Next
interactive.tooltip: Go to the next tool in the list; the numbered steps compute on arrival when a source is known.

interactive.label: Run all
interactive.tooltip: Walk the rest of the numbered pipeline, each step when the previous has finished; press again to stop.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Read how detector setup, calibration and shared HDF5 are propagated.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through the imaging workflow.

interactive.label: Image browser
interactive.tooltip: Browse the folder: file list, detector-window mosaic, ratings, annotations and exports.

interactive.label: Detector setup
interactive.tooltip: Detector routing, PIE windows, reading routine, TAC corrections and optical setup (the shared setup editor).

interactive.label: Open folder
interactive.tooltip: Choose a folder with TTTR photon files; its files are listed on the left. You can also drop a folder on the window.

interactive.label: Clear
interactive.tooltip: Clear the file list and the preview. No file, rating or annotation is changed or deleted.

interactive.label: Clear caches
interactive.tooltip: Delete the cached mosaics of the opened folder (the .tttr_image_cache folders, in memory and on disk). They are rebuilt when a file is selected.

interactive.label: Copy raw files
interactive.tooltip: Copy the selected raw photon files into a folder you choose, keeping their paths relative to the opened folder. Select files first.

interactive.label: TIFF
interactive.tooltip: Write the intensity stack of every detector window of the selected files as a TIFF into a folder you choose. Select files first.

interactive.label: DOCX
interactive.tooltip: Write a Word report of every listed file (name, rating, annotation and the mosaic) to the file you choose; it starts in the opened folder.

interactive.label: Next → Intensity
interactive.tooltip: Send the current image to the imaging pipeline and open its Intensity step. Only available when this browser runs inside Imaging Tools.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the detector setup, the file list, the mosaic and the exports.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through the browser step by step; each step waits for you to use the control it points at.

interactive.label: Include subfolders
interactive.tooltip: Also list the files of the sub-folders of the opened folder. Switching it lists the folder again.

interactive.label: folder_text
interactive.tooltip: The opened folder. Use Open folder, or drop a folder on the window.

interactive.label: Multiple selection
interactive.tooltip: A click on a row adds it to the selection or removes it. Copy raw files and TIFF act on the selection.

interactive.label: Select all
interactive.tooltip: Select every row the filters show, so that Copy raw files and TIFF act on all of them.

interactive.label: annotation
interactive.tooltip: A note for the file shown. It is saved at once beside the data in .image_browser_meta.json.

interactive.label: gamma
interactive.tooltip: Lift dim structures with a gamma above one. Display only: the pixel values and the exports are unchanged.

interactive.label: Auto levels
interactive.tooltip: Map the lowest and the highest pixel value of the mosaic to the ends of the colour scale. Switch it off to set the levels, or drag the two lines in the histogram.

interactive.label: level_low
interactive.tooltip: Lower display level (0 to 254). Needs Auto levels off.

interactive.label: level_high
interactive.tooltip: Upper display level (1 to 255). Needs Auto levels off.

interactive.label: Tile labels
interactive.tooltip: Write each tile's detector, micro-time range and routing channels on the mosaic.

interactive.label: Reset view
interactive.tooltip: Show the whole mosaic again after zooming (mouse wheel) or panning (drag).
